name: gaspol-one
description: The GASPOL suite in one marketplace — ship code (gaspol-dev), raise money (gaspol-pitch), and sell to operations buyers (gaspol-catalog). Every plugin gates its output behind an adversarial review that blocks weak work before it leaves your machine.

plugins.name: gaspol-dev
plugins.description: 17 skills + 4 agents that make Claude Code run its checks instead of reading its code: a per-phase verification loop (baseline, then fail-fast typecheck/unit/build before every checkpoint), a Live App Check that actually launches the app — web through the Playwright MCP, mobile through adb on a real device or emulator — plus a geometry diff against a data-vv-marked canvas, a regression gate that blocks a bug fix with no checked regression test, anti-placeholder enforcement, an always-on completeness ladder, a batch gate so one report mints one ticket, a post-plan design-artifact offer whose refusal must carry a written reason, step-level plan verification, git-worktree isolation, a cross-project knowledge base, and an auto-trigger bootstrap. A check that did not run is never recorded as passed. Design intelligence delegates to the ui-ux-pro-max plugin; security review to the CLI built-in /security-review.

plugins.name: gaspol-pitch
plugins.description: 7 skills orchestrating investor/accelerator pitch decks: discovery -> narrative -> draft -> adversarial investor review -> visual -> finish. Reuses installed marketing skills as the engine; the differentiator is a rubric-driven skeptic-investor linter that scores and blocks a weak deck before you send it. Outputs a Marp markdown deck + one nano-banana-pro image prompt per slide (MCP-optional).

plugins.name: gaspol-catalog
plugins.description: 7 skills orchestrating B2B sales catalogs and offer decks for operations buyers, not investors: reads your own knowledge base first and interviews only the gaps, then storyline, then master catalog once, per-prospect variant many times, a visual phase that authors the render prompts, a two-layer blocking gate that reviews the text AND the rendered image, and a finish phase that writes what was learned back. Inherits the adversarial review engine from gaspol-pitch and swaps the rubric.
